lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a transition to higher density and smaller diameters towards the anterior head section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with larger circular spots to form a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, running parallel across the upper two-thirds of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-contrast white linear band/scar is visible near the distal tip of the right pectoral fin. An additional high-luminance irregular patch is visible at the pectoral fin's posterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark silhouettes representing commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral region below the pectoral fin.
